== What changed on the image ==

Compared with [[ComScan Detection (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as before. This is a full card image, 350 × 490 pixels, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The earlier slip and the same area of this card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
